اصطدمت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَدَمْتُ (iṣṭadamtu) /isˤ.tˤa.dam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اِصْطَدَمْتَ (iṣṭadamta) /isˤ.tˤa.dam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اِصْطَدَمْتِ (iṣṭadamti) /isˤ.tˤa.dam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اِصْطَدَمَتْ (iṣṭadamat) /isˤ.tˤa.da.mat/: thi
